title: On Measuring Faithfulness or Self-consistency of Natural Language Explanations
reasoning: The paper's title explicitly mentions "Faithfulness," and the core content of the paper involves designing and evaluating "faithfulness tests" for natural language explanations generated by LLMs. It defines faithfulness as accurately reflecting the reasoning process for a trustworthy AI and introduces a new metric (CC-SHAP) and a Comparative Consistency Bank (CCB) for evaluating self-consistency related to faithfulness. The "Ethics Statement" also highlights the goal of locating harmful model properties, behavior, and biases, which aligns with an ethical dimension related to evaluating model explanations.
